simpleJp: ヴェローナの街で情報収集してサーカスへ向かう
jpGuide1:
―自由行動―
街の人々に話し掛けると、店・サーカス・酒場など行ける場所が増えていく
enGuide: Talk to the townspeople to open locations. Check the notebook regularly; repeatedly talking to the one-winged angel also reveals a hidden basement. General free-action mechanic: after all commands are available, a Japanese Wazap source documents one repeat-talk item per free-action window by speaking to the same NPC at least twice; treat this as background guidance, not one chapter-2 action standing in for future windows. Concrete required/missable pickups are called out at their actual windows.

simpleJp: BATTLE 2-1「前略サーカスにて」をクリア
enGuide: Defeat all enemies. Finish low-HP enemies promptly because they can use healing items.
